distribution: Redis Software RAM, one shard; not Redis Community, Flex or a Cluster API topology.
management_tls: Local fixture self-signed bootstrap trust mode
observation_scope: Same owned Software fixture; management/QPF/noeviction gates also ran immediately before every live invocation. Server/container allocation stayed unchanged.

native_client.network_route: Linux client shares the owned Software network namespace; certificate/hostname verified TLS at localhost; bypasses macOS published-port path.

go_diagnostic_client.network_route: Host loopback to Docker published TLS port. Diagnostic profiles, including mixed writer pilot/long, retain this actual environment; do not relabel them as Linux native timings.

topology_control_resources.scope: OS/route/runtime/resources are explicit controlled-run differences; no single OS or network component is assigned the cause.
